A little bit about us

You chased. I finally said yes.

And somehow… look at us now. 🤍

You spent years chasing me, and when I joined B.E. first year, I finally gave you a chance.

Honestly, I don't think I knew then how much you'd become part of my everyday life.

Now you're the person I look for, laugh with, argue with, complain to… and still want at the end of the day.

Very annoying. Very loved. Unfortunately, both are true. 😂❤️
